Personalization.title: Personalization & Amazing Deals
Personalization.subtitle: Manage real-sale campaigns, recommendation placements, privacy and engine health without creating a parallel pricing engine.

overview.canonicalPricingBody: Displayed discounts are derived from the real product price and resolvePrice; this feature does not create a second discount engine.
overview.noFakeLiftBody: Until experimentation is available, revenue and conversion are descriptive attribution only, not causal incrementality.
overview.consentAwareBody: Personalization consent is independent from marketing consent; no behavioral profile is built without it.

campaigns.title: Amazing-deal campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Choose products with real active sales manually, intelligently, or with controlled rotation.

builder.title: Create campaign
builder.subtitle: Only published, genuinely discounted products enter the pool and the backend revalidates them at publish time.
builder.name: Campaign name

homepage.title: Homepage merchandising
homepage.subtitle: Control the Amazing Deals section without replacing the existing featured-products area.

placement.title: Recommendation placements
placement.subtitle: Each placement can be disabled independently and falls back to generic recommendations without consent.

simulator.title: Decision simulator
simulator.empty: Run the simulator to inspect the selection path.

help.systemState: Shows feature flag and kill-switch state.
help.events: First-party events recorded for the current tenant.
help.exposures: Persisted exposures with request/exposure IDs; they are not stored without suitable consent.
help.attribution: This phase reports descriptive attribution only; causal lift requires experiments and holdouts.
help.campaignName: Operational name used in the admin and reports.
help.selectionMode: Manual, highest-valid-discount smart mode, stable controlled rotation, or pinned + automatic hybrid.
help.minDiscount: Products below this real effective discount are ineligible.
help.maxItems: Maximum products served; invalid items never backfill the requested count.
help.realProducts: The picker uses the real published product API and the backend rechecks sale windows and inventory.
help.homepageEnabled: Controls only the Amazing Deals section, not the rest of the homepage.
help.homepageCampaign: Pin a campaign or let the service select the current active campaign.
help.homepageLimit: The section shrinks when fewer eligible products exist.
help.placement: The recommendation surface; disabling it preserves its configuration.
help.simulator: Runs the real recommendation service as a dry-run-like inspection without changing commerce state.
help.simulatorPlacement: Page context used by candidate selection and ranking.
help.health: Shows engine status, policy version and last-event time.
help.consents: Analytics and personalization consent are stored separately.
help.privacy: Purpose limitation, profile reset and emergency controls.
help.killSwitch: Immediately disables automatic personalization while core pricing and storefront remain independent.
